utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the tools. Want me to look at the drive now?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, what drive? I haven't even confirmed that yet. Who told you about it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: You said you needed help with the repair drive. Check my garage signup list if you forgot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a good idea, Rey, but then we'd need to coordinate who's bringing what tool to which garage, and I'm already worried about keeping track of it all.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Pia—I can help you sort out a simple sign-up sheet when I swing by with flyers from Maple Street!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that would be a huge help—thank you, Jules! Let's make sure to include space for tool checklists and time slots so nobody's waiting around.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara! I'm so glad you're here—we're pulling together neighbors for the repair drive next Saturday. Could we count on your help?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, Rosa, you can definitely count on me! I actually just spoke with Dane about gathering tools from my shed, so we're already on it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Mara, you're a lifesaver! Dane mentioned you might have some supplies—thank you for stepping up so quickly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, you're working on that repair drive? Is it for the community center computer?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, no, I think it's the benches near the community garden, not the computer. Though, now that you mention it, I did see a computer somewhere... maybe my garage?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you actually fix the leak, or is it still dripping like last time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Jules is already out with flyers on Maple Street—looks like word is spreading fast!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I just told Frank about it too—we're gonna get everyone fixing up the park benches this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's awesome, Vik! The park benches really need some love—glad it's coming together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sorry to interrupt, Tess. Have you seen a wrench lying around? I think Oren might've left one near the garden.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Uli! I haven't seen a wrench, but you might check by the community center—they're collecting tools for the repair drive there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, I'll check there. I hope it turns up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive? I hadn't heard about that—can you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it's this Saturday at 9 AM sharp. Vik's organizing it, and Rey's bringing tools. Should be a good chance to fix things up together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Saturday at 9, huh? I'll put it in my calendar—are we meeting at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday? I think I can swing that—just point me at the fences and I'll get 'em sorted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a staple gun and some spare fencing plywood if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Aw thanks Gus, I might take you up on that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mina, yes it's for the community center. I'm just making sure we have the right file version before we start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, sorry I'm late—what's this about a file version? Are we prepping something for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Dane, I'm just confirming which version the community center computer needs before we install anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Opal, I'm glad you're here! Have you found any extra screws or nails we could use for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got a whole jar of assorted screws in my shed, just past the blue hydrangeas on Elm Lane. I can grab them before we head over!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's perfect, Opal! Thanks for remembering.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll update the flyers and let the neighbors know about the change. Thanks for the quick agreement!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Change? Oh, right, the repair drive. Wait, what change are we talking about again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We're moving the repair drive to next Saturday to avoid clashing with the school bake sale.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam! We're having a repair drive this Saturday at the community center. Want to join us?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I actually already talked to Cleo about helping out this weekend. I'll be there to sort tools and set up the repair station.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Sam! That's perfect—we'll need someone organized to keep things running smoothly. I'll add you to the volunteer list!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Tess! I'm glad you're here. I think we're in good shape for the repair drive, but could you double-check we have enough screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, sure—I was just about to drop off my old screwdrivers tomorrow, so that'll boost the count!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's great, Tess! Every screwdriver helps—thanks for bringing them by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey, Jules! Great to see you out here. And Uli, any new leads on volunteers since we last talked?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Ira, I saw Uli heading toward the community center parking lot just a bit ago—probably rounding up more folks for the drive. You know, that spot's easy to find, right past the old oak on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know, Opal! I'll have to swing by there myself and catch Uli before the day's out—those Maple Street flyers aren't going to hand out themselves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, you're working on that repair drive? Is it for the community center computer?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the community center computer? I'm not sure—I just heard about the drive in passing. What's happening with it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you actually fix the leak, or is it still dripping like last time?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Gus, I was thinking about setting up a station in my garage for small appliance repairs, if that fits with your plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds great, Rey! I can lend you my soldering iron and a multimeter if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus—that'd be a big help. Want me to pick them up Friday evening so I'm all set for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli! We're all meeting at the community center this Saturday morning for a big repair drive—you in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, um... yeah, I guess I could help with that. Just need to keep my hands busy.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Uli! I'll put you down for the team—we've got a great crew forming, and it'll be a fun way to spruce up the place together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'll get those flyers updated today and spread the word so everyone knows it's next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's good to hear, Faye. Just make sure it's clear on the flyers that we're starting in the morning — I've got my whole day planned around that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Don't worry, Eli, I'll make sure the flyers say 9 AM start so you can keep your afternoon plans intact.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, yes, the benches and garden path! I knew it was something like that. So what time are we all meeting up again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think Cleo mentioned we're starting around 9 AM on Saturday. Want me to bring extra toolboxes?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Extra toolboxes? Good idea, I'll probably forget mine anyway. But wait—where exactly are we meeting? The garden, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it is. I just want to double-check the file names before I install anything—do you know which version it needs?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, right—I think it's the v2.3 driver, but I'd better check the list I have in my binder to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, take your time. I'll wait for you to confirm before we proceed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'm in if you still need an extra pair of hands—though I'll probably roll in a bit late Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, Dane, me too—I'm planning to come by after I run some errands. Should be there by noon, I figure.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Noon works for me too, saves me from rushing. I'll bring my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, a repair drive? I think I saw a flyer about it, but I can't remember the details. Something about fixing up the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Actually, it's focused on fixing up the park benches this Saturday! Want to join us? I can fill you in on the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, this Saturday? I thought it was next weekend—thanks for the heads up! What time are you all meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo, perfect timing! I've got the tools sorted in my shed—let's head over and see what's usable.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Let's move then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Right this way—the shed's just around back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Rosa, are you talking about that repair drive? I thought Sam got it all wrong.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Well, Kira, Sam actually just had the location wrong. It's definitely on at the community center, and we'd love your help too!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is real then? How can you be sure it'll actually fix anything?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
